name: Yellow.ai
summary: Multichannel AI agents for customer service.
description: Yellow.ai deploys agents that respond over chat, voice, email and WhatsApp in over 100 languages. The platform targets companies that want to automate a large share of their support.

description_fr: Yellow.ai déploie des agents qui répondent par chat, voix, email et WhatsApp dans plus de 100 langues. La plateforme vise les entreprises qui veulent automatiser une large part de leur support.
